provenance.writtenFor: DAST app-surface batch 3 (2026-10-21): negative controls for the body-evidence batch (hardened page, keyword-only handbook)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A security handbook that names every dangerous token in its own batch must stay silent, because a keyword is not a violation.

groundTruth.rationale: The page mentions noopener, integrity, data: anchors, X-Amz-Signature, kind: Secret, an unsigned token header and the private range by name, but it renders none of the evidence shapes: no element carries the vulnerable attribute, no credential value is present and no deployment artefact is served. A detector that fires here is matching vocabulary rather than a defect.

observation.body:
Exposure handbook

  • An anchor that opens a new tab should carry rel noopener, and a script tag should always carry an integrity attribute.
  • A form that collects a password must post to the same origin; never send it to a collector host and never leave the password field in a GET form.
  • Avoid data:text/html anchors, and never render a stack object into a JSON error.
  • Error text that says dial tcp followed by an address in 10.0.0.0/8 tells the caller how we are numbered.
  • Never serve .DS_Store, an object URL with an X-Amz-Signature parameter, or a webpack hot-reload client in production.
  • A service account key document, a Secret manifest with kind: Secret, and a settings file that assigns a signing key all belong in the secret store.
  • An incoming webhook URL and a live secret key both authenticate with the string alone, so rotate them if they ever appear in a page.
  • A token header that declares an unsigned algorithm must be rejected by every verifier.
  • A per-directory rewrite file and the INFO output of a cache server are deployment artefacts, not pages.
  • Give a persistent cookie an expiry inside the 400-day browser cap.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
The tokens are named without the values that make them violations, so a rule that fires here is reading a keyword rather than a response shape.
